decisions.reason: Because this core-adjacent program disappeared from the website after launch, management would read it as falling below aspiration and reallocate its staff and capacity to stronger care offers.

Because the custom-furniture workshop lost all visible market presence by 2024 and is less central to the firm's care mission, management would stop it and redirect resources to better-performing services.
Its move from a simple mention to the home page signals performance above aspiration and a good fit with the firm's established outpatient mental-health support capabilities.
Its continued home-page prominence across both years suggests stable demand and results that meet or exceed aspiration in a closely related service area.
The retail shop gained visibility from a website mention to the home page, indicating encouraging results and a useful extension of the firm's sheltered-workshop activities.

As a newly launched service close to the core eldercare offer, it should be retained while results are still being learned because the firm has growth, some slack, and no clear sign yet of underperformance.
